43000.name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStubStartDateBusinessCenters
43000.description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

43001.name: UnderlyingPaymentStubStartDateBusinessCenter
43001.description:
The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the payment stub start date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

43002.name: UnderlyingProvisionBreakFeeElection
43002.description: Type of fee elected for the break provision.

43003.name: UnderlyingProvisionBreakFeeRate
43003.description: Break fee election rate when the break fee is proportional to the notional. A fee rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

43004.name: UnderlyingRateSpreadInitialValue
43004.description: Specifies the initial rate spread for a basket underlier.

43005.name: NoUnderlyingRateSpreadSteps
43005.description: Number of entries in the repeating group.

43006.name: UnderlyingRateSpreadStepDate
43006.description: The date that the rate spread step takes affect.

43007.name: UnderlyingRateSpreadStepValue
43007.description: The the value of the new rate spread as of the UnderlyingRateSpreadStepDate(43006).

43008.name: NoUnderlyingReturnRateDates
43008.description: Number of iterations in the return rate date repeating group.

43009.name: UnderlyingReturnRateDateMode
43009.description: Specifies the valuation type applicable to the return rate date.

43010.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationDateRelativeTo
43010.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the return rate valuation dates are relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

43011.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationDateOffsetPeriod
43011.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative return rate valuation date offset.

43012.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationDateOffsetUnit
43012.description: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation date offset.

43013.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationDateOffsetDayType
43013.description: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation date offset.

43014.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationStartDateUnadjusted
43014.description: The unadjusted start date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

43015.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationStartDateRelativeTo
43015.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the return rate valuation start date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

43016.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationStartDateOffsetPeriod
43016.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

43017.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationStartDateOffsetUnit
43017.description: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

43018.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationStartDateOffsetDayType
43018.description: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

43019.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationStartDateAdjusted
43019.description: The adjusted start date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

43020.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationEndDateUnadjusted
43020.description: The unadjusted end date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

43021.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationEndDateRelativeTo
43021.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the return rate valuation end date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

43022.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationEndDateOffsetPeriod
43022.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

43023.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationEndDateOffsetUnit
43023.description: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

43024.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationEndDateOffsetDayType
43024.description: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

43025.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationEndDateAdjusted
43025.description: The adjusted end date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

43026.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationFrequencyPeriod
43026.description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which return rate valuation dates occur.

43027.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationFrequencyUnit
43027.description: Time unit associated with the frequency at which return rate valuation dates occur.

43028.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationFrequencyRollConvention
43028.description: The convention for determining the sequence of return rate valuation dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency.

values.meaning: The floating rate note convention or Eurodollar convention.
The International Money Market settlement date, i.e. the 3rd Wednesday of the month.
The last trading day/expiration day of the Canadian Derivatives Exchange.
The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange Australian 90-day bank accepted bill futures contract.
The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange New Zealand 90-day bank bill futures contract.
The Sydney Futures Exchange 90-day bank accepted bill futures settlement dates.
The 13-week and 26-week U.S. Treasury Bill auction dates.

43029.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationDateBusinessDayConvention
43029.description: The return rate valuation dates business day convention.

43030.name: NoUnderlyingReturnRateFXConversions
43030.description: Number of iterations in the return rate FX conversion repeating group.

43031.name: UnderlyingReturnRateFXCurrencySymbol
43031.description: Specifies the currency pair for the FX conversion expressed using the CCY1/CCY2 convention. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

43032.name: UnderlyingReturnRateFXRate
43032.description: The rate of exchange between the two currencies specified in UnderlyingReturnRateFXCurrencySymbol(43031).

43033.name: UnderlyingReturnRateFXRateCalc
43033.description: Specifies whether UnderlyingReturnRateFXRate(43032) should be multiplied or divided.

43034.name: NoUnderlyingReturnRates
43034.description: Number of iterations in the return rate repeating group.

43035.name: UnderlyingReturnRatePriceSequence
43035.description: Specifies the type of price sequence of the return rate.

43036.name: UnderlyingReturnRateCommissionBasis
43036.description: Specifies the basis or unit used to calculate the commission.

43038.name: UnderlyingReturnRateCommissionCurrency
43038.description: Specifies the currency the commission amount is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

43040.name: UnderlyingReturnRateDeterminationMethod
43040.description:
Specifies the method by which the underlier prices are determined.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

43041.name: UnderlyingReturnRateAmountRelativeTo
43041.description:
Specifies the reference amount when the return rate amount is relative to another amount in the trade.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/payment-amount-relative-to for code list of relative amounts.

43042.name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteMeasureType
43042.description:
Specifies the type of the measure applied to the return rate's asset, e.g. valuation, sensitivity risk. This could be an NPV, a cash flow, a clean price, etc.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/asset-measure for values.

43043.name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteUnits
43043.description:
Specifies the units that the measure is expressed in. If not specified, the default is a price/value in currency units.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/price-quote-units for values.

43044.name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteMethod
43044.description: Specifies the type of quote used to determine the return rate of the swap.

43045.name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteCurrency
43045.description: Specifies the currency the return rate quote is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

43046.name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteCurrencyType
43046.description:
Specifies the type of currency, e.g. settlement currency, base currency, etc., that the quote is reported in.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/reporting-currency-type for values.

43047.name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteTimeType
43047.description: Specifies how or the timing when the quote is to be obtained.

values.meaning: As specified in the master confirmation

43048.name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteTime
43048.description: The time when the quote is to be generated.

43049.name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteDate
43049.description: The date when the quote is to be generated.

43050.name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteExpirationTime
43050.description: The time when the quote ceases to be valid.

43051.name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteBusinessCenter
43051.description:
The business center calendar used for adjustments associated with UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteTimeType(43047) or UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteTime(43048) and UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteDate(43049), e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

43052.name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteExchange
43052.description: Specifies the exchange (e.g. stock or listed futures/options exchange) from which the quote is obtained.

43053.name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuotePricingModel
43053.description:
Specifies the pricing model used to evaluate the underlying asset price.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/pricing-model for values.

43054.name: UnderlyingReturnRateCashFlowType
43054.description:
Specifies the type of cash flows, e.g. coupon payment, premium fee, settlement fee, etc.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/cashflow-type for values.

43055.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationTimeType
43055.description: Specifies the timing at which the calculation agent values the underlying.

values.meaning: As specified in the master confirmation

43056.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationTime
43056.description: The time at which the calculation agent values the underlying asset.

43057.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationTimeBusinessCenter
43057.description:
The business center calendar used for adjustments associated with UnderlyingReturnRateValuationTimeType(43055) or UnderlyingReturnRateValuationTime(43056) , e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

43058.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationPriceOption
43058.description: Indicates whether an ISDA price option applies, and if applicable which type of price.

43059.name: UnderlyingReturnRateFinalPriceFallback
43059.description: Specifies the fallback provision for the hedging party in the determination of the final price.

43060.name: NoUnderlyingReturnRateInformationSources
43060.description: Number of iterations in the return rate information source repeating group.

43061.name: UnderlyingReturnRateInformationSource
43061.description: Identifies the source of rate information. For FX the references source to be used for the FX spot rate.

43062.name: UnderlyingReturnRateReferencePage
43062.description:
Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source.
For FX, the reference page to the spot rate to be used for the reference FX spot rate.
When UnderlyingReturnRateInformationSource(43061) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions.
See: https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

43063.name: UnderlyingReturnRateReferencePageHeading
43063.description: Identifies the page heading from the rate source.

43064.name: NoUnderlyingReturnRatePrices
43064.description: Number of iterations in the return rate price repeating group.

43065.name: UnderlyingReturnRatePriceBasis
43065.description: The basis of the return price.

43066.name: UnderlyingReturnRatePrice
43066.description: Specifies the price of the underlying swap asset.

43067.name: UnderlyingReturnRatePriceCurrency
43067.description: Specifies the currency of the price of the underlying swap asset. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

43068.name: UnderlyingReturnRatePriceType
43068.description: Specifies whether the UnderlyingReturnRatePrice(43066) is expressed in absolute or relative terms.

43069.name: NoUnderlyingReturnRateValuationDateBusinessCenters
43069.description: Number of iterations in the return rate valuation date business center repeating group.

43070.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationDateBusinessCenter
43070.description:
The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the return rate valuation unadjusted or relative dates, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

43071.name: NoUnderlyingReturnRateValuationDates
43071.description: Number of iterations in the return rate valuation date repeating group.

43072.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationDate
43072.description: The return rate valuation date. Type of date is specified in UnderlyingReturnRateValuationDateType(43073).

43073.name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationDateType
43073.description: Specifies the type of return rate valuation date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

43074.name: NoUnderlyingSettlMethodElectionDateBusinessCenters
43074.description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

43075.name: UnderlyingSettlMethodElectionDateBusinessCenter
43075.description:
The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the settlement method election unadjusted or relative date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

43076.name: UnderlyingSettlMethodElectionDateUnadjusted
43076.description: The unadjusted settlement method election date.

43077.name: UnderlyingSettlMethodElectionDateBusinessDayConvention
43077.description: The settlement method election date adjustment business day convention.

43078.name: UnderlyingSettlMethodElectionDateRelativeTo
43078.description:
Specifies the anchor date when the settlement method election date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

43079.name: UnderlyingSettlMethodElectionDateOffsetPeriod
43079.description: Time unit multiplier for the relative settlement method election date offset.

43080.name: UnderlyingSettlMethodElectionDateOffsetUnit
43080.description: Time unit associated with the relative settlement method election date offset.

43081.name: UnderlyingSettlMethodElectionDateOffsetDayType
43081.description: Specifies the day type of the relative settlement method election date offset.

43082.name: UnderlyingSettlMethodElectionDateAdjusted
43082.description: The adjusted settlement method election date.

43083.name: UnderlyingStreamVersion
43083.description: The stream version identifier when there have been modifications to the contract over time. Helps signal when there are embedded changes.

43084.name: UnderlyingStreamVersionEffectiveDate
43084.description: The effective date of the UnderlyingStreamVersion(43083).

43085.name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalDeterminationMethod
43085.description:
Specifies the method for determining the floating notional value for equity swaps.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

43086.name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalAdjustments
43086.description: For equity swaps this specifies the conditions that govern the adjustment to the number of units of the swap.

43087.name: PaymentDesc
43087.description: A short descriptive name given to the payment, e.g. Premium, Upfront, etc. The description has no intrinsic meaning but should be arbitrarily chosen by the remitter as reference.

43088.name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndexID
43088.description: Security identifier of the floating rate index.

43089.name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndexIDSource
43089.description: Source for the floating rate index identified in LegPaymentStreamRateIndexID(43088).

values.meaning: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

43090.name: PaymentStreamRateIndexID
43090.description: Security identifier of the floating rate index.

43091.name: PaymentStreamRateIndexIDSource
43091.description: Source for the floating rate index identified in PaymentStreamRateIndexID(43090).

values.meaning: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

43092.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndexID
43092.description: Security identifier of the floating rate index.

43093.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndexIDSource
43093.description: Source for the floating rate index identified in UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndexID(43092).

values.meaning: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

43094.name: DeliveryStreamRouteOrCharter
43094.description: Specific delivery route or time charter average. Applicable to commodity freight swaps.

43095.name: LegDeliveryStreamRouteOrCharter
43095.description: Specific delivery route or time charter average. Applicable to commodity freight swaps.

43096.name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamRouteOrCharter
43096.description: Specific delivery route or time charter average. Applicable to commodity freight swaps.

43097.name: PaymentFixedRate
43097.description: The rate applicable to the fixed rate payment.

43098.name: PaymentFloatingRateIndex
43098.description: The payment floating rate index. See SpreadOrBenchmarkCurveData(221) for suggested values.

43099.name: PaymentFloatingRateIndexCurvePeriod
43099.description: Time unit multiplier for the floating rate index.

43100.name: PaymentFloatingRateIndexCurveUnit
43100.description: Time unit associated with the floating rate index.

43102.name: PaymentFrequencyPeriod
43102.description: Time unit multiplier for the payment frequency.

43103.name: PaymentFrequencyUnit
43103.description: Time unit associated with the payment frequency.

43104.name: PaymentRateResetFrequencyPeriod
43104.description: Time unit multiplier for the floating rate reset frequency.

43105.name: PaymentRateResetFrequencyUnit
43105.description: Time unit associated with the floating rate reset frequency.

43106.name: PaymentStreamOtherDayCount
43106.description: The industry name of the day count convention not listed in PaymentStreamDayCount(40742).

43107.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamOtherDayCount
43107.description: The industry name of the day count convention not listed in UnderlyingPaymentStreamDayCount(40572).

43108.name: LegPaymentStreamOtherDayCount
43108.description: The industry name of the day count convention not listed in LegPaymentStreamDayCount(40283).

43109.name: PaymentStreamFormulaLength
43109.description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) PaymentStreamFormula(42648) field.

43110.name: LegPaymentStreamFormulaLength
43110.description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) LegPaymentStreamFormula(42486) field.

43111.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulaLength
43111.description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormula(42982) field.

43113.description: The source of the payment stream's second floating rate index.

43114.description: Security identifier of the second floating rate index.

43115.description: Source for the second floating rate index identified in PaymentStreamRateIndex2ID(43114).

43116.description: The payment stream's second floating rate index.

43117.description: The source of the payment stream's second floating rate index.

43118.description: Security identifier of the second floating rate index.

43119.description: Source for the second floating rate index identified in LegPaymentStreamRateIndex2ID(43118).

43120.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndex2
43120.description: The payment stream's second floating rate index.

43121.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndex2Source
43121.description: The source of the payment stream's second floating rate index.

43122.name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndex2ID
43122.description: Security identifier of the second floating rate index.

43123.description: Source for the second floating rate index identified in UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndex2ID(43122).
